title: IDIQ for Ventilation Ducting - 11 various items
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEFENSE LOGISTICS AGENCY.DLA MARITIME.DLA MARITIME SHIPYARDS.DLA MARITIME - PORTSMOUTH
detail_text: IDIQ for Ventilation Ducting PNS intends to solicit for the purchase of Ventilation Ducting for the Portsmouth Naval Shipyard, Kittery, ME. This requirement will be solicited as a 100% Small Business Set Aside (SBSA) procurement, and the size status for this requirement is 800 employees. Additional details will be provided shortly.
